hero.title: GitHub Pages CI/CD
hero.subtitle: Edit content, push to Git, watch the pipeline, see it live
hero.lead: This demo runs on a Raspberry Pi at home. Change the text and theme below, deploy, and watch GitHub Actions build and ship the update through Cloudflare Tunnel.
hero.sub: Scroll down to see how commits flow from push to live site — or open the editor and trigger a real deployment.

about.title: About
about.lead: What this demo shows and how it stays in sync with your repo.
paragraphs: This is a hands-on CI/CD demo: content lives in Git, GitHub Actions builds the site, and your Pi serves the result.
Every deploy is a real commit. You can watch each workflow step complete before the live site updates.
